answer: Harbor-terrace public-table bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and posts a signed terrace tally to the harbor table each epoch. Anyone may recompute the table: each tally must ripple-match the previous row's hash, so a rented tally fails at once. A mismatch burns the bond, flagging the row. Forging costs 38 for the first fake, 38+6(k-1) for the k-th, so 1,000 fakes burn 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38.
